title: Customers
summary: Two decades in consumer finance and telecom, ending with seventeen years leading Credit & Collections at Vodafone — where customer value and risk had to be managed as one.

title: Ventures
summary: From running a function to building things: business head at Vaux, his own advisory practice, and two books that turn experience into method.

title: Institutions
summary: Teaching, governance and service — the slower work of building things that outlast the people who start them.

callout.title: Back where he learned
callout.text: He finished school at Burhani College in 1981 and earned his PGDBM at Sydenham Institute in 1985. Today he teaches at both.
